description: Overwrite a cell range (A1 notation) in a spreadsheet with a 2D grid of values. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Write a 2D grid into an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet, starting at the top-left cell of an A1 range and interpreting formulas, dates, and formatted numbers as user-entered values. The grid dimensions define the cells replaced; the rest of the named range retains its existing contents.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with updated_cells, the count of cells written.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm how many cells were updated and in which range. This is a write action — be explicit that existing data in the range was overwritten.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Overwrite a cell range in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id/range, or values is empty or not a list of row lists. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty 2D values grid matching the range. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
